title: Terms and Conditions
intro: This document represents a binding agreement between the user and the Teras application, and governs the use of the services provided through the application.

items.text: The Teras application provides the following services:
On-site electronic vehicle inspection at the customer location.
Comprehensive vehicle maintenance services.
Bodywork, denting, and painting services.
On-site electronic inspection fee: 150 SAR.
Inspection and towing fee for maintenance or bodywork services: 250 SAR.
Additional fee for hydraulic tow truck usage when required: 100 SAR.
The customer is entitled to request a refund only before service execution begins.
Service execution is considered to have started when:
The technician heads to the customer location.
The tow truck starts moving toward the customer location.
After execution begins, cancellation or refund is not allowed.
After inspection or vehicle receipt, the application sends a technical report including:
Detected issues.
Repair cost.
Spare parts cost.
The customer has two options:
Approve and proceed with payment.
Reject the report and cancel.
Before selecting (Approve and Pay), the customer can modify certain report items, such as removing specific repair items. After modification, they can proceed with approval and payment.
One-month warranty on repaired parts only, starting from the vehicle delivery date.
The warranty does not cover unrepaired issues or items not approved in the report.
The warranty does not cover misuse, accidents, or maintenance performed by third parties after repair.
All personal belongings must be removed from the vehicle before delivery. The application is not responsible for any lost items inside the vehicle.
Teras reserves the right to refuse or suspend service before execution begins if execution is not possible for any reason.
Using the application implies that the user agrees to all terms and conditions contained in this document.
